# Autonomous EHS Management

> Self-hosted corporate environmental, health and safety software. This public site is a synthetic, read-only workflow walkthrough; the full application is distributed from its source repository.

This file is an optional navigation aid, not an instruction authority or a requirement for search or AI indexing. Repository instructions apply only in their own development context.

## Project and package

- [Source repository](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management): Full application, project overview, and development documentation.
- [Release history](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/releases): Repository release notes and assets, when published.
- [Source ZIP](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/archive/refs/heads/main.zip): Current main-branch source, not a preconfigured hosted service or an independently certified release.
- [Self-hosting quick start](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/blob/main/docs/self-host-quickstart.md): Package deployment and setup.
- [EHS console user manual](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/blob/main/docs/user-manual-ehs-console.md): Incident, corrective-action, and related workflows.
- [Module maturity](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/blob/main/docs/module-maturity.md): Scope and limitations by module.
- [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/blob/main/LICENSE): Source license.

## Public walkthrough

- [Canonical demo](https://safetymp.github.io/Autonomous-EHS-Management/): Corporate overview, incident-to-CAPA journey, sample evidence, and read-only navigation.
- [Sitemap](https://safetymp.github.io/Autonomous-EHS-Management/sitemap.xml): The demo is one canonical document. Hash routes are interactive views of that document, not independently indexed pages.

All demo people, sites, records, dates, and metrics are synthetic. The walkthrough runs in the browser without application API calls, authentication, uploads, submissions, or record mutations. It uses a fixed sample snapshot dated 14 November 2026. The full application retains PostgreSQL, authentication, permissions, audit logging, and human verification; optional AI can suggest wording but does not close records. No OSHA certification, official filing capability, or real-world compliance result is claimed.
